split_reasoning: Design, construction, and maintenance produce different work products at different stages of a website's life.

parts.text: Design a website or a defined website feature.
parts.type_reasoning: The design is a distinct artifact used by the development team.
parts.unit_reasoning: A design for a defined feature or site is handed over as a whole.

parts.text: Build a website or a defined website feature using development and content tools.
parts.type_reasoning: Each implementation produces a distinct website component for review or release.

parts.work_item: one implemented website feature or component

parts.end: component submitted for review or deployment

parts.text: Maintain an existing website by making a requested change or correction.

parts.unit_reasoning: A requested change or correction is normally tracked and completed as a unit.
parts.end: change completed and submitted for release

notes: Shares are approximate and vary with the site's development stage.

split_reasoning: Performing updates and directing other people to perform them are different activities.
